mike_dev: FYI hitting a weird one in the sampleapp where logs sometimes contain raw user emails despite our redaction hook. looks like race during boot + retry path.
anya: ack - can you paste a tiny repro log? is this Node or Go sample?
mike_dev: node. repro attached below. note the sequence: 1) request arrives, 2) auth retry triggers, 3) log hook fires after retry and sees unmasked header.
mike_dev: ```
INFO  startup - req_id=abc123 user=redacted@example.com action=start
WARN  auth.retry - req_id=xyz789 auth=failed
INFO  handler - req_id=xyz789 user=raw@example.com action=proxy
```
ben_platform: ouch. looks like our OTEL/log hook attaches req_id from initial context but we re-issue a new request id on retry and the scrubber only runs for the original flow. ordering issue.
jen_sre: can you share minimal snippet for the middleware order? in node express we usually have:
```
app.use(reqIdMiddleware)
app.use(otelMiddleware)
app.use(logRedactMiddleware)
app.use(authRetryMiddleware)
```
jen_sre: if authRetryMiddleware can mutate headers and re-run handlers, logRedactMiddleware needs to be after that, or better: redact at emit-time not attach-time.
anya: emitting-time scrub sounds right. otherwise you end up snapshotting sensitive fields before they're canonicalized. can we change the SDK loghook to grab headers from the final response context?
ben_platform: quick patch I tried: move logRedactMiddleware to the very end and switch redact to run in a logging transport hook (on 'beforeSend'). small diff:
```diff
- logger.attachContext(req)
- logger.redactOnAttach()
+ logger.attachContext(req)
+ logger.on('beforeSend', () => logger.redact(currentContext))
```
ben_platform: that prevented the raw email leak in my local retry loop.
mike_dev: nice. one other hiccup: some devs rely on request-id being stable across retries for tracing. moving redact to emit-time is fine but we should preserve a stable req_id invariant or expose both: original_req_id + attempt_id.
anya: yeah keep original_request_id and attempt_id. also add a flag in SDK config: redactOnEmit: true/false so teams can opt in while we roll out.
jen_sre: can we add a short unit test in sampleapp verifying redaction remains when auth retry returns a 401 then 200? I can add a tiny mocha test.
ci-bot: deploy queued for branch fix/loghook-emit-redact (build #8421) :github:
anya: awesome — once CI passes let's ship to rolling staging for a couple hours then a canary. I'll add a telemetry check for "unredacted-email" count.
mike_dev: thanks all — I'll open a PR with the middleware reorder + config flag and the mocha test. will ping when ready. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: build #8421 passed unit tests (15s).
anya: merging after one more approve.
jen_sre: small follow-up todo: update docs about req_id vs attempt_id and recommended logging patterns in sampleapp README.
mike_dev: added the README note in the PR.
anya: great, closing thread once canary metrics look clean.
